snippet.title: Possessor(s) Launch Trailer | Luca & Rhem | Available Now on PS5 + PC
snippet.description:
Out now on PS5 and Steam: https://www.possessorsgame.com/

0:00 Animated Trailer
0:54 Gameplay

Possessor(s) is a fast-paced action side scroller with combat inspired by platform fighters, a story told through dangerous characters, set in a deep interconnected world ready for exploration.

Set in the sprawling ruins of Sanzu City, Possessor(s) follows Luca, a high-schooler whose life is shattered by an interdimensional catastrophe. Gravely injured, she forms an uneasy pact with Rhem, a powerful demon in need of a host. Together, they’ll fight to survive, uncover the truth behind the disaster, and confront the horrors lurking within the city’s fractured heart.

Blending the precision combat of platform fighters with the exploration of Metroidvanias, Possessor(s) delivers stylish, combo-driven action and deep traversal mechanics across a richly detailed, interconnected world. Players will explore devastated skyscrapers, flooded aquariums, and other haunting environments—all beautifully realized with hand-drawn characters over striking 3D backdrops.
